text:
ITEM 1 | Square white plate about 26 cm across used as scale; a cluster of bright green, thin, elongated pieces with a few darker tips, slightly glossy and limp, arranged in a loose heap on the left side covering roughly 12% of plate area, about 8 cm long strands, piled about 1.5 cm high | 45
ITEM 2 | Pale off-white cooked grain, moist and slightly sticky, separate grains visible with soft clumped texture, forming a mound on the lower-left of the plate covering roughly 10% of plate area, about 7 cm by 4 cm, about 2 cm high, sitting beside the green pieces | 85
ITEM 3 | Pale golden-brown meat pieces with a lightly browned, slightly glossy exterior and fibrous texture, two portions on the right side: one larger slice about 6 cm by 4 cm and roughly 1.5 cm thick, one smaller piece about 4 cm by 3 cm, together covering roughly 15% of plate area, with dark browned edges and caramelized bits | 110
ITEM 4 | Small amount of translucent brown-green glazed onion or pepper pieces with soft, slightly oily sheen, scattered in thin strands about 4 cm long over and beside the meat slices, covering roughly 3% of plate area, about 0.5 cm high | 15
ITEM 5 | A few small bright green flat herb leaves with ruffled edges, scattered near the bottom center of the plate between rice and meat, covering about 2% of plate area, about 3 cm across total, very thin | 5
ITEM 6 | Scattered small crumbs and bits of pale light-brown material, a few pieces about 0.5 cm each, dry and crumbly, lying loose on the plate near the rice and meat, covering under 1% of plate area | 3
